name: Array Balancing
justification: Clean independence observation, one-liner loop, unambiguous single-number output.
solution_sketch: Swapping (a_i,b_i) affects only adjacent pair costs, and each adjacent pair can be optimized independently: cost_i = min(|a_i-a_{i+1}|+|b_i-b_{i+1}|, |a_i-b_{i+1}|+|b_i-a_{i+1}|). Sum the minima.
